denoisingReason: This Blender build has no OpenImageDenoise support; the final images use more samples instead.
geometry: Exact exported Three.js meshes and world matrices, with the existing Santa María model and immediate cartographic context.
materials: Base and vertex colours preserved; masonry bump approximated. Canvas textures are not emulated by this exporter.
illumination: Two sunlight sources, environment and a broad inspection fill in the open square.

images.review: Entire plaza and retained Santa María are visible with adjoining houses; former triangular gable gaps are closed.
Lowered arch, separate voussoirs, recessed timber leaves and four-bar shield are legible. Shield clears gallery beams. The CanvasTexture number plate is blank in this geometry-only CPU translation.
Low view is inside the actual gallery volume, with successive arches, soffit beams, recessed domestic wall and open side towards the square; no black frame or camera inside a wall.
